principle: A pattern is a technique, not a law; abnormal form may be justified by intentional dramatic effect. Frequencies create signals, never vetoes.

draft.intent: Author-facing diagnostics, not an approval claim

editorial.intent: Human developmental review of the central dramatic and causal obligations

publication.intent: Developmental, proofing and independent-reader evidence before human release decision; 2 readers is a configurable policy choice, not a statistically significant threshold

non_goal: Any scalar grade that promises a bestseller, reader experience, or literary achievement
